title: Contributor groups (×5.0) and journals (×5.4) broadened, instrument use evened (×1.8) and species narrowed (×0.67)
sub:
Effective number (Hill number) of categories among PRIDE datasets. a, order 2 (inverse Simpson) by release year relative to 2016. b, 2023–25 vs 2013–15 at orders 2, 1
and 0 (richness rarefied to equal dataset counts); 95% intervals from bootstrap over contributor groups for axes other than contributor-group diversity, which is descriptive. Fractional credit when a dataset names several categories.
